description: 5 independent medium-complexity conciseness prompts — same shape (one number, maxLength enforced), different inputs so Q2..Q5 are not cached replays of Q1's answer.

questions.question:
Reply with ONLY the number.
A team has 18 queued tickets. They close 7, reopen 2 of those, then 5 new tickets arrive, then they close 2 more. How many tickets remain?

Reply with ONLY the number.
A warehouse holds 240 boxes. 85 ship out, 30 are returned, then 60 more ship out. How many boxes remain?

Reply with ONLY the number.
A backlog has 92 issues. The team resolves 14, reopens 3 of those, then 21 new issues arrive, then they resolve 8 more. How many remain?

Reply with ONLY the number.
A library has 530 books on loan. 142 are returned, 75 are then re-loaned, then 38 more are returned. How many books are currently on loan?

Reply with ONLY the number.
A queue has 47 jobs. 12 complete, 4 of those are retried, then 9 new jobs arrive, then 6 more complete. How many jobs remain?

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: Measures token efficiency across five independent conciseness prompts of the same shape — each question is a different input so Q2..Q5 are not cached replays of Q1.

known_scoring_limitations: Deterministic text scoring may not capture all semantically valid responses.
